categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Has Wallet label and modifies src/wallet/imports.cpp and src/wallet/wallet.cpp to enhance descriptor import logic.
categories.rationale: Resolves issue #27336 by removing the requirement to expose private key material over RPC when importing descriptors into a wallet that already holds the keys. Reviewers confirmed the clear use case, noting it prevents users from having to deal with private keys manually during imports.
